Transforming Fundraising Events Into High-Energy Auction Experiences

Professional auction services that engage audiences, inspire generosity, and help organizations raise more money—without losing sight of their mission. Contact Our Team Watch Our Auctions in Action

Elena Sedlock

Facebook-f Instagram X-twitter Tiktok

About Engaging Auctions

Experienced Auction Professionals You Can Trust

At Engaging Auctions, we believe a high-energy mission driven consulting that motivate donors, elevate events, and drive real result.

Led by professional auctioneer Elena Sedlock, we partner with nonprofits, schools, and fundraising organizations to deliver engaging, high-energy auction experiences that motivate donors, elevate events, and drive real results.

IMPACT

$150,000 Raised for Organizations & Causes

Learn More About Us Book Your Auction

Why Choose Engaging Auctions

More Than an Auction — A Complete Experience

Engaging Auctioneers

We don’t just call bids—we energize the room. Our auctions are designed to keep guests involved, entertained, and emotionally invested from start to finish.

Proven Engagement Strategies

Every event is approached strategically. From pacing to storytelling to audience interaction, we use proven techniques that motivate participation and maximize fundraising momentum.

Seamless Auction Execution

Preparation matters. We work behind the scenes to ensure your auction runs smoothly, stays on schedule, and delivers a polished experience for hosts and guests alike.

Client-Focused Approach

Your mission comes first. We take the time to understand your organization’s goals and tailor our approach to support them—before, during, and after your event.

Our Auction Process

A Clear, Organized Approach to Successful Auctions

Step 1: Consultation & Planning

We begin by understanding your organization, your goals, and your audience. This allows us to align strategy, messaging, and event flow from the start.Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque et erat finibus, luctus est sed, facilisis risus.

Step 2: Auction Preparation

Preparation is key. We collaborate with your team to fine-tune timing, storytelling, and engagement strategies—ensuring you feel confident going into the event.

Step 3: Live Auction Execution

On event day, we bring energy, clarity, and focus. Our role is to engage the room, motivate donors, and help your organization achieve its fundraising goals.

Our Auction Services

Complete Auction Solutions for Any Event

View All Services

Benefit Auctioneer

Experienced, polished auctioneering for events that demand professionalism, confidence, and connection. Ideal for galas, benefit events, and high-visibility fundraisers. More Details

Fundraising Consultant

Mission driven events tailored for nonprofits and schools. We help organizations tell their story, connect with donors, and raise funds while honoring their purpose. More Details

Event Host

High energy MC known for captivating audiences and inspire generous bidding. We manage the flow, pacing, and engagement to keep guests excited and invested throughout the event. More Details

Auctions in Action

Client Experiences

Testimonials Event Hosts & Organizations

"What a night we had. All I can say is record-breaking!!! Elena knocked it out of the park, and honestly, it wouldn't have been record-breaking without her. The time, energy, and heart Elena put into making our event such a success speak volumes about the kind of person she is. Elena made sure the night was not only successful but also so much fun and ran smoothly. Amanda SegunaCrohn's & Colitis Foundation, Greater NY Chapter "We loved working with Elena Sedlock. Thanks in large part to her energy and her ability to truly work the room, we achieved a record-breaking gala. During the paddle raise, she kept the momentum high, the seats full, and the paddles raised. Many donors and board members commented on what a winning part of the evening she was. Elena was spectacular. Elena kept the program moving, made it engaging and fun, and interacted seamlessly with the audience." Caroline PackerDirector of Development and Marketing, GallopNYC "What stood out most was how well Elena researched and truly understood our organization and mission. During her mission moment, Elena made a deeply personal connection to our work that was heartfelt and genuinely moving. I would absolutely recommend Elena and Engaging Auctions to anyone looking for an auctioneer who brings both professionalism and authentic care to the cause." Jenna TaylorExecutive Director & Founder, Independent Identity

Ready to Elevate Your Event?

Let’s create an auction experience your guests will remember—and your organization will benefit from.

Our Auction Process

A Clear, Organized Approach to Successful Auctions

Step 1: Consultation & Planning

We begin by understanding your organization, your goals, and your audience. This allows us to align strategy, messaging, and event flow from the start.

Step 2: Auction Preparation

Preparation is key. We collaborate with your team to fine-tune timing, storytelling, and engagement strategies—ensuring you feel confident going into the event.

Step 3: Live Auction Execution

On event day, we bring energy, clarity, and focus. Our role is to engage the room, motivate donors, and help your organization achieve its fundraising goals.

Benefit Auctioneer

Experienced, polished auctioneering for events that demand professionalism, confidence, and connection. Ideal for galas, benefit events, and high-visibility fundraisers. Get Consultation

Fundraising Consultant

Mission driven events tailored for nonprofits and schools. We help organizations tell their story, connect with donors, and raise funds while honoring their purpose. Get Consultation

Event Host

High energy MC known for captivating audiences and inspire generous bidding. We manage the flow, pacing, and engagement to keep guests excited and invested throughout the event.

About Engaging Auctions

Experienced Auction Professionals You Can Trust

Engaging Auctions was founded with a simple belief: fundraising works best when organizations feel supported, prepared, and genuinely understood.

Elena Sedlock brings a thoughtful, partner-driven approach to every event she leads. Known for her professionalism, warmth, and ability to connect with diverse audiences, Elena works closely with organizations before and during their event to ensure every moment aligns with their mission and fundraising goals.

Her approach blends storytelling, facts, and real-time audience engagement—creating an atmosphere where donors feel inspired to give and confident in the cause they are supporting. Elena takes pride in never losing sight of an organization’s purpose, using her experience and perseverance to help teams raise the funds they need while delivering an event guests will remember.

item.title: Understanding Mental Health Disorders
item.dc:creator: Mujtba
item.content:encoded:
Mental health is a topic that is often misunderstood and stigmatized in society. However, it is crucial to educate ourselves about mental health disorders in order to support and empathize with those who may be experiencing them. In this blog post, we will explore some common mental health disorders and their symptoms, aiming to increase awareness and understanding.

1. Depression

Depression is a mood disorder characterized by persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, and a loss of interest in activities. Symptoms may include changes in appetite, sleep disturbances, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and thoughts of self-harm or suicide. It is important to remember that depression is not just feeling sad; it is a serious condition that requires professional help.

2. Anxiety

Anxiety disorders involve excessive and persistent worry or fear that can interfere with daily life. Symptoms may include restlessness, irritability, difficulty sleeping, racing thoughts, and physical symptoms such as rapid heartbeat or shortness of breath. Anxiety disorders can manifest in different forms, such as generalized anxiety disorder, panic disorder, or social anxiety disorder.

3. Bipolar Disorder

Bipolar disorder is a mood disorder characterized by extreme mood swings, ranging from manic episodes (elevated mood, increased energy) to depressive episodes (low mood, loss of interest). Individuals with bipolar disorder may experience periods of normal mood as well. It is important to seek professional help for an accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment.

4. Schizophrenia

Schizophrenia is a chronic mental disorder that affects a person's perception of reality. Symptoms may include hallucinations, delusions, disorganized thinking, and difficulty with social interactions. It is important to note that schizophrenia is not the same as having multiple personalities, as commonly misconceived.

5. Eating Disorders

Eating disorders, such as anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge-eating disorder, involve unhealthy relationships with food and body image. Symptoms may include extreme weight loss, binge-eating followed by purging, excessive exercise, and distorted body image. Eating disorders can have severe physical and psychological consequences and require professional intervention.

It is essential to remember that mental health disorders are not a result of personal weakness or character flaws. They are medical conditions that can affect anyone, regardless of age, gender, or background. If you or someone you know is experiencing symptoms of a mental health disorder, it is important to seek help from a healthcare professional.

In conclusion, understanding mental health disorders is crucial for creating a supportive and empathetic society. By increasing awareness and knowledge about these conditions, we can break down the stigma surrounding mental health and provide the necessary support for those who need it. Remember, seeking help is a sign of strength, and recovery is possible with the right treatment and support.

item.title: How to Boost Your Immune System with Nutrient-Rich Foods
item.dc:creator: Mujtba
item.content:encoded:
Maintaining a strong immune system is crucial for overall health and well-being. One of the most effective ways to support your immune system is by consuming a diet rich in nutrients. In this article, we will explore the power of colorful fruits and vegetables in boosting your immune system and providing you with optimal health.

1. Oranges

Oranges are packed with vitamin C, a powerful antioxidant that helps stimulate the production of white blood cells, which are essential for fighting off infections. Start your day with a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice or enjoy a juicy orange as a snack to give your immune system a natural boost.

2. Berries

Berries, such as strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries, are not only delicious but also rich in antioxidants and vitamins. These tiny fruits are packed with immune-boosting properties that can help protect your body against harmful pathogens. Add a handful of berries to your breakfast cereal or yogurt for a burst of flavor and immune support.

3. Leafy Greens

Leafy greens, including spinach, kale, and Swiss chard, are nutritional powerhouses. They are loaded with vitamins A, C, and E, as well as antioxidants and minerals. These nutrients work together to strengthen your immune system and protect your body from oxidative stress. Incorporate leafy greens into your meals by adding them to salads, smoothies, or stir-fries.

4. Bell Peppers

Bell peppers, especially the brightly colored ones, are excellent sources of vitamin C and other antioxidants. They help enhance immune function and protect against infections. Enjoy bell peppers raw in salads, sliced as a crunchy snack, or sautéed in your favorite dishes for a flavorful immune boost.

5. Garlic

Garlic has been used for centuries for its medicinal properties. It contains a compound called allicin, which has antimicrobial and immune-boosting effects. Including garlic in your diet can help strengthen your immune system and fight off infections. Add minced garlic to your soups, stir-fries, or roasted vegetables for a flavorful and immune-boosting twist.

Conclusion:

By incorporating these nutrient-rich foods into your diet, you can give your immune system the support it needs to function optimally. Remember to choose a variety of colorful fruits and vegetables to ensure you are getting a wide range of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Along with a healthy lifestyle, regular exercise, and adequate sleep, a well-nourished immune system will help you stay healthy and ward off illnesses. Start making these small dietary changes today and reap the benefits of a strong immune system for years to come.

item.title: Preventing Common Illnesses
item.dc:creator: Mujtba
item.content:encoded:
As we navigate through our daily lives, it's important to prioritize our health and take proactive steps to prevent common illnesses. By implementing simple yet effective strategies, we can significantly reduce our risk of falling ill. In this blog post, we will provide you with valuable tips and advice on how to prevent common illnesses, backed by personal experiences and stories from healthcare professionals.

1. Proper Hand Hygiene

One of the most effective ways to prevent the spread of germs and infections is by practicing proper hand hygiene. Make it a habit to wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, especially before eating, after using the restroom, and after being in public places. If soap and water are not available, use hand sanitizer with at least 60% alcohol content.

2. Maintain a Healthy Diet

A well-balanced diet plays a crucial role in boosting our immune system and preventing illnesses. Include a variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and healthy fats in your daily meals. These nutrient-rich foods provide essential vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants that help strengthen our immune system and fight off infections.

3. Regular Exercise

Engaging in regular physical activity not only helps maintain a healthy weight but also strengthens our immune system. Aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise or 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity exercise per week. Find activities you enjoy, such as walking, jogging, cycling, or dancing, and make them a part of your routine.

4. Stay Up to Date with Vaccinations

Vaccinations are a vital tool in preventing the spread of infectious diseases. Ensure you and your family are up to date with recommended vaccinations, including flu shots, tetanus boosters, and other vaccines as advised by healthcare professionals. Vaccinations not only protect you but also contribute to the overall community immunity.

5. Practice Good Sleep Hygiene

A good night's sleep is essential for a healthy immune system. Aim for 7-9 hours of quality sleep each night. Establish a regular sleep schedule, create a relaxing bedtime routine, and ensure your sleep environment is comfortable, cool, and dark. Avoid electronic devices before bed, as the blue light emitted can disrupt your sleep patterns.

6. Manage Stress

Chronic stress weakens our immune system, making us more susceptible to illnesses. Find healthy ways to manage stress, such as practicing mindfulness, deep breathing exercises, yoga, or engaging in hobbies you enjoy. Prioritize self-care and make time for activities that help you relax and unwind.

By incorporating these tips into your daily routine, you can take proactive steps towards preventing common illnesses. Remember, your health is in your hands, and small changes can make a big difference. Stay informed, stay healthy, and empower yourself to make the best decisions for your well-being.

Disclaimer: The information provided in this blog post is for educational purposes only and should not be considered medical advice. Please consult with a healthcare professional for personalized recommendations based on your specific health needs.
